description: This file implements device identification methods for a Raspberry Pi (RPI) within a plugin framework. It provides functions to retrieve firmware version, device serial number, architecture, and chipset information, interfacing with system and hardware details.

classes.name: DeviceImplementation
classes.description: Implements device identification by retrieving firmware version, serial number, architecture, and chipset information for a Raspberry Pi. It adheres to the IIdentifier interface for providing a device ID.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns the device identifier (serial number) as a byte array, up to the specified length.

methods.name: UpdateFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Updates the firmware version string by executing system command 'version'.

methods.name: UpdateDeviceIdentifier
methods.description: Reads the device serial number from the system file.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: Executes a system command to retrieve the firmware version via 'vc_gencmd' and processes the output.
